title: The Harbor Museum Bronze Falcon Theft
description: Fictional test case: Investigation into the disappearance of a bronze falcon statue from the maritime gallery.

evidence.title: Display Pedestal Load Sensor Log
evidence.content: Display pedestal load sensor in Gallery 3 recorded an immediate pressure drop from 8.5kg to 0.0kg at 22:15:00 UTC.

evidence.title: Night Docent Patrol Statement
evidence.content: Docent Arthur Pendelton claims he shone his torch directly onto the Gallery 3 pedestal at 22:30 UTC and observed the falcon statue in its customary position.

evidence.title: Facilities Breaker Trip Incident Report
evidence.content: West Wing circuit breaker 4B tripped at 22:14:50 UTC due to a transient power surge, causing a 15-second switch-over to auxiliary battery backup.
